value.rationale: The study solves the full weight-dependent operator problem on the canonical nonnilpotent derived-one-dimensional Leibniz family in every dimension, and yields motivated rank/geometric invariants. The nonzero-weight count is exactly twice the zero-weight count even though its reduced variety has twice as many irreducible components and changes connectedness; invertible operators appear only at nonzero weight. These results go beyond low-dimensional tables and are useful complete structural information for this algebra family.
